story_paragraphs.text: BLESSTech-X is a digital solutions company founded by Barack Blessings and Sylvester Mwila in Lusaka, Zambia. We build websites, e-commerce stores, and digital systems that help Zambian businesses grow.

PhoneYa2 Accessories is one of the ventures born from BLESSTech-X — a practical example of what we build for our clients. We saw a gap in the market for affordable, genuine phone accessories delivered fast in Lusaka, so we built PhoneYa2 to fill it.
PhoneYa2 is an active e-commerce venture where we keep improving the product catalogue, ordering experience and customer support for shoppers in Zambia.

venture_text: PhoneYa2 is a practical example of what we build for our clients — a real, working business that serves the Zambian market.
hero_sub: PhoneYa2 Accessories is a BLESSTech-X venture — bringing genuine phone accessories and quality service to Lusaka.
businesses_intro: Explore the businesses and projects we build, operate and grow. You can add a new venture, its logo, story and website from the CMS.
cta_text: PhoneYa2 is our proof that digital solutions work. Browse the catalogue, review product details and contact our team if you need help before ordering.

team.name: Barack Blessings
team.bio: Barack leads the vision and operations at BLESSTech-X, personally ensuring every digital solution meets the quality standard he'd expect for himself. Passionate about tech, community, and building something Zambia can be proud of.

team.name: Sylvester Mwila
team.bio: Sylvester is a ZICA-certified accountant with expertise in financial planning, tax compliance, and sustainable growth strategies for Zambian SMEs. He ensures every BLESSTech-X venture is financially sound.
